risks.title: Automatic triggers bypassing activation limits
risks.evidence: TriggerQueueManager.resolvePendingQueue() calls reserveRestriction() before RESOLVING (engine/triggers.js:247), and AsyncResolver.resolveAbility() calls reserveRestriction() before any clause executes (engine/resolver.js:465), so both queued triggers and direct EventBus triggers enforce OPT/OPG/SAME_NAME limits.

risks.title: Same-name effect tracking sufficiency
risks.evidence: buildRestrictionKey() keys ONCE_PER_TURN_SAME_NAME on turnNumber:player:same_name:cardName:semanticId and ONCE_PER_GAME_SAME_NAME on game:player:same_name:cardName:semanticId (engine/restrictions.js:556-593), cleanly distinguishing players, abilities, and shared-name copies.

risks.title: Once-per-game tracking keys & reset isolation
risks.evidence: OPG keys use game:player:card:cardId:physicalId (scope GAME); resetRestrictions(state, "TURN") only resets TURN/STEP/BATTLE/ATTACK scopes and never resets GAME scope (engine/restrictions.js:1594).

risks.title: Effect consumption and failed resolution
risks.evidence: Cost clauses commit only after costPaid === true (engine/resolver.js:289-303). Targeting clauses commit only after targeting succeeds and is not declined (lines 314-327). Failed costs abort immediately and release reservation in finally (lines 621, 666).

risks.title: Lifecycle resets & battle context cleanup
risks.evidence: FlowController.advanceStep() resets TURN/STEP/BATTLE/ATTACK scopes atomically and clears state.combat on leaving ATTACK/END. However, selectors/conditions checked state.battle while declareAttack/declareBlock set state.combat (K0-DEF-01 & K0-DEF-02), now fixed.
